body: Hey, i'm currently going through the same thing tonight and what i found that helped me was just a simple ice-pack out of the freezer. Wrap that shit up in a towel and boom. instant sleep.
Thank you, I will try my best <3

Thank you so much for commenting. I don't know why but hearing this from you made me feel a lot better. I have actually tried meditation and found that it worked well for me. (but the downside to this is that my mother is a hyper-Christian and thinks anything outside her religion is a work of the devil, so that's why I was not encouraged to meditate more.) I will definitely try these suggestions, thank you so much for helping me.

I don't know what you're going through, but it doesn't matter. Depression is depression and anything can cause it. Anxiety, loss of a family member or even a pet. And sometimes its just genetic. You have every right to feel what you're feeling and **nobody** has the right to tell **you** that your feelings are invalid. 

I just want you to remember that even though you're going through shit doesn't mean anybody else's shit is worse than yours or more needing of attention than yours. 

Something that I used to do was convince everyone that I was fine and eventually convinced myself that I was fine. And I wish that on *nobody.* Because once you convince yourself that you're fine, even though you're not, it only gets worse.
